1) Short-term voucher: 2 weeks of pro sandbox credits, limited to the Portside test workspace, non-transferable.
2) Calendarized access: grant access tied to a milestone token — we lift access for testing until PO is received, then we reconcile usage against the incoming PO.

If you want the voucher today I can ask Sales Ops to approve an interim token and send a PDF with the usage limits and expiry. To proceed I need: (a) the name on the PO, (b) expected PO amount (ballpark), and (c) contact at procurement if they want a formal request.

I'll loop in Priyom for approval and Marissa to keep your renewal rep in the loop. If helpful I can also lock the voucher to specific model/route IDs to control spend.

Next steps: reply with the three items above and confirm which option you prefer — I can have the voucher out within the day after approvals.
